episodes.synopsis: An old tale from long ago, that began in a village far, far away. There, a wolf brought bountiful harvests of wheat for an exceedingly long time, until memories of the wolf became antiquated stories. What then, was left for the wolf to do?
episodes.title: The Harvest Festival and the Crowded Driver's Box

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence and Holo stay overnight in the town where they sell the furs. As Lawrence learns more about Holo, Holo learns about the current state of the Church and shares her own wisdom.
episodes.title: Mischievous Wolf and No Laughing Matter

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in the great merchant city of Pazzio, Lawrence teaches Holo more about the many kinds of currency in use. Then the Wise Wolf earns her keep - and her title - by demonstrating her bargaining skills.
episodes.title: Port Town and Sweet Temptation

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence has figured out the truth behind the silver scheme, and how to profit from it, but in doing so he has made some dangerous enemies.  Meanwhile, Holo and Lawrence discuss his grand plans for the future.
episodes.title: Romantic Merchant and Moonlit Farewell

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence reveals Holo's secret to the manager of Milone Trading Company to gain their help in securing Holo's escape. For merchants, money comes first, so why has Medio Trading captured Holo at all? Lawrence must outthink politics to save Holo.
episodes.title: Wolf Incarnate and Obedient Lamb

episodes.synopsis: Holo and Lawrence are trapped in the tunnels below the city, with hunters searching for them in all directions.  When danger comes, how far will they go to protect each other?
episodes.title: Merchant and Unreasonable God

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence and Holo continue on to the next city to sell the pepper and pick up their next goods on the long journey north. Holo puts her nose to good use, once again.
episodes.title: Scale of God and Sorcerer of the Grasslands

episodes.synopsis: Our travelers encounter a shepherd along the road.  Can the Wise Wolf hold back against an enemy of wolves long enough for Lawrence to build more contacts?
episodes.title: Fellow Traveler and Foreboding News

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence is ready to sell the armor for a great profit and Holo wants her peaches. But when things don't go to plan, will either get what they want?
episodes.title: Sweet Honey and Bitter Armor

episodes.synopsis: Desperate for money, the wise Wolf proposes a dangerous new plan. But even more dangerous are Holo's emotions, when Lawrence is being rather dense...
episodes.title: Wisdom of a Wolf and Smooth Talk of a Merchant

episodes.synopsis: Nora leads the way into the dangerous woods, and so their risky plan commences. What dangers truly lurk in the woods? Are a brave shepherd and a Wise Wolf strong enough to overcome what lies ahead?
episodes.title: Forest of Wolves and Frigid Rain

episodes.synopsis: Betrayed and left for dead, Lawrence waits for Holo's return. Holo is no weak wolf to run off with her tail between her legs, and Lawrence the merchant won't lose his profit either. But will a wolf be willing to save a shepherd?
episodes.title: Price of Betrayal and Price of Gold

episodes.synopsis: Holo, Lawrence, and Nora sit down for a much deserved meal, but Holo's not her usual self. Holo remembers the past and contemplates the future...
episodes.title: Supper of Three and Afternoon of Two

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence and Holo continue their long journey north, reaching the town of Kumerson, where they see the first northern pagans of their journey.
episodes.title: New Town and Nostalgic Feeling

episodes.synopsis: With no real information on how to get to Yoitsu, Lawrence uses all his resources to find more information. Will pagan stories of the North yield any clues?
episodes.title: Bird Feather and Mysterious Ore

episodes.synopsis: Amati learns about Holo's debt to Lawrence and announces that he will take on the debt and ask Holo to marry him.
episodes.title: Night of the Festival and Misaligned Gear

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence tries to persuade Amati into a special deal. This could determine the outcome of their agreement...
episodes.title: Traveling Merchant's Shallow Thinking and Town Merchant's Signboard

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence seeks help from Mr. Batos to acquire pyrite from the alchemists. When he speaks with Diana, she makes him an offer...
episodes.title: Goods of Intent and Negotiation of Resolve

episodes.synopsis: The price of pyrite keeps rising, but when Diana's representative appears and informs him of the failed deal, Lawrence's plan collapses. Has he lost the bet against Amati and, consequently, Holo?
episodes.title: God's Unseen Hand and Wolf's Unseen Heart

episodes.synopsis: With a load of flour, Holo and Lawrence head deeper into the north, arriving at the town of Tereo, searching for an abbey with information on Holo's home.
episodes.title: Church Girl and Miller Boy

episodes.synopsis: A friendly evening of drinking at the tavern reveals the true beliefs of the villagers, but how are they able to live so comfortably with the church bearing down on them? Lawrence investigates further, and Holo identifies a miracle she'd like to perform.
episodes.title: Pagan Village and Priest's Contract

episodes.synopsis: Meeting with Elsa in the church, Lawrence and Holo are able to learn the truth about Father Franz's studies as Elsa reveals a hidden secret of the church, and the true location of the Abbey.
episodes.title: Church Teachings and Memories of Father

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence and Holo are being used as scapegoats because a person in Enberch died from poisoned wheat from the village of Tereo. How can the two get themselves out of this trap?
episodes.title: Orchestrated Catastrophe and Appropriate Retribution

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence, Evan, and Elsa manage to escape from the village on Holo's back. As they take a rest, they observe men from Enberch heading towards Tereo...
episodes.title: Path of the Snake God and Answer of the Wise Wolf

episodes.synopsis: Elsa's plan succeeds. After Bishop Mendez and the men from Enberch witness the miracle, they leave the village of Tereo alone. Shortly thereafter, Lawrence and Holo plan to continue their journey...
episodes.title: Miracle's Path and Journey's Continuation
